title: Who searches the state's camera network
subtitle: Agencies that ran plate searches on Texas DPS cameras during June
source: Texas Tribune review of a month of DPS search records
alt: Bar chart of law enforcement agencies that searched the Texas Department of Public Safety license plate camera network during June: 396 agencies inside Texas and 2,679 agencies from outside Texas ran searches, while 206 Texas departments had signed access agreements with DPS as of July
